purpose.zh: 练手撑平衡和肩膀往前顶的劲
purpose.en: Builds hand balance and the shoulder strength to lean forward over your hands.

text.zh: 肩膀往前送过手，两脚离地
text.en: Lean your shoulders past your hands and lift your feet

text.zh: 蹲着两手撑地，手指稍微朝外，手臂伸直。
text.en: Crouch with your hands flat, fingers turned slightly out, arms straight.

text.zh: 膝盖收在胸口下面，背微微拱起，稳住。
text.en: Knees tucked under your chest, back slightly rounded. Hold the balance.

commonErrors.en: Lifting your feet before leaning forward.

cautions.zh: 人往前送，手腕压力很大，先活动开，疼就停
cautions.en: Leaning forward loads your wrists a lot. Warm them up and stop if they hurt.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼就少撑几秒，还疼就停；撑不住就脚尖点地，只练肩膀往前送
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, hold for less time. Stop if it still hurts. Can't lift off? Keep your toes down and just practise leaning forward.

changes: 主口令原来塞了 4 个指令，缩成一件事：肩膀往前送过手、双脚离地；锁臂/拱背挪到 cues
training=hold（动画全程离地静止定住 8 s）
剂量 3 组×8 秒、休息 90 秒不变（共用词已补 sec.90）
相位口令「放下双脚」→「别憋气」（计时类不写回来）；补退阶「脚尖点地只练前送」
难度 v3 3 / ai-tags 4 → 统一 3
